name: unreal-agent-hub
description: A queue for shared resources of AI coding agents and scripts on one or many machines: the Unreal editor, C++ builds, cooks, GPU laptops. Advisory locks with priorities, machine roles, presence ("I am at this machine"), handover requests and a live board.

role.title: Role of this machine
role.description: hub (keeps the queue and the board; exactly one machine) or node (any other machine).

node_id.title: Machine id
node_id.description: Short id of this machine, as the hub's config names it (default: the host name).

hub_url.title: Hub URL (nodes only)
hub_url.description: Where a node reaches the hub, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18791 through the reverse ssh tunnel.

token.title: Node token (nodes only)
token.description: The token `hub node add <id>` printed on the hub.
